name: Wikilink Alias Markup
tip: Write markup in the alias of a link, for example [[Obsidian|`obsidian`]] or [[The TeXbook|*The TeXbook*]]. Put the cursor in the link to edit the source.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Wikilink Alias Markup is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
